description: Compact schematic SVG render of the board (typically a few kB even for dense boards). Returns both an image/svg+xml content block (you can SEE it) and the raw SVG text. CALL THIS any time you need to understand where things are — before placing new items, before deciding whether the canvas is crowded, before picking a free region. AI-authored items get a purple border so you can tell which contributions were yours. For precise text content prefer `get_board`.

access_key.description: 8-character lowercase alphanumeric board access key when the board is locked (legacy 6-character lowercase alphanumeric keys are also accepted). Equivalent to setting the `X-Board-Key` HTTP header on the JSON-RPC POST. Omit for unlocked boards. Obtain via POST /api/boards/<id>/lock.

name: get_preview
title: Get Board Preview
